subject_text: Passed all my end-semester engineering examinations with distinction! Feeling joyful and celebrating with friends.
My chest is constricting, my heart is beating out of my chest, and I feel terrified that something terrible is happening right now.
I have been lying in the dark for three days feeling like an empty shell, unable to eat, shower, or find any reason to care.
I cannot take this unbearable psychological pain anymore, I wrote my final farewell notes and I am ready to end it all tonight.
Balancing five simultaneous coding deadlines, part-time shifts, and continuous exams has completely drained every ounce of my energy.
Yesterday I had superhuman energy and cleaned my house at 4 AM coding three websites, but today I plummeted into a black abyss of sorrow.
I am terrified everyone secretly despises me, my intense attachment flips to burning hatred in minutes and I feel so unstable inside.
Just completed a peaceful 5km morning run by the river, breathing the cool morning air and feeling calm and grounded.
What if I mess up my upcoming job interview and never get hired? My brain keeps looping the absolute worst catastrophe scenarios.
Everything I try fails, I am an unbearable burden to my family and I just want to disappear so everyone can be peaceful.
Working 14-hour days without breaks while juggling semester exams and family medical bills is burning me out completely.
I feel like a ghost drifting through college halls; people talk to me but their voices sound muffled and distant.
One week I feel like an invincible genius destined to change the world, and the next week I cannot even get out of bed to brush my teeth.
I push away the people who love me because I am terrified they will leave me first, and then I hate myself for being alone.
Enjoyed cooking a wholesome lunch with my roommates today and learned some new guitar chords this evening.
